issues.detail: The Greek 'συμβουλιον δε λαβοντες' means 'having taken counsel' or 'after consulting,' but the Vietnamese 'bàn bạc xong' (finished discussing) implies a completed action of discussion that isn't explicitly stated as 'finished'. More importantly, the Greek does not contain any reference to 'số bạc đó' (that amount of silver); it simply says they bought the field. The addition of 'số bạc đó' introduces a specific object/source not present in the Greek text.
